caption: The drawing shows a round, reddish-brown shield with a textured, hammered surface and multiple bands of raised, decorative patterns forming concentric circles. The central area features a heart-shaped motif with intricate carved details and what appears to be a small black cross in the middle. Two ornate, gold-colored metal fittings or hinges are attached to the side, with one on the left and the other on the right. The background is plain and uncolored. The artist's signature, "W. Hierckhegel," is visible in small text in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Baptismal Font
